_note: Thunder Max combo moves. Inputs are D-pad sequences (combo_up/down/left/right actions, remappable). Each press must come within window_s of the last. Moves with "hold": true only fire while the combo hold control (RT by default) is held. Edit freely: names, inputs, costs and effects are all ours.

scrap_mine.name: Scrap Mine
scrap_mine.description: Drops a spiked charge behind you. Arms after half a second.

cold_snap.name: Cold Snap
cold_snap.description: A coolant round that seizes the target's engine and wheels.

spring_jack.name: Spring Jack
spring_jack.description: Hydraulic rams kick the car into the air. Hop walls, dodge mines, land on roofs.

rivet_storm.name: Rivet Storm
rivet_storm.description: Hold RT and run the long code: the rivet guns fire twice as fast, hit harder and never overheat for a few seconds.

fire_jug.name: Fire Jug
fire_jug.description: A lobbed jug of burning fuel. Leaves a fire pool that sets cars alight.

tailgunner.name: Tailgunner
tailgunner.description: A heavy round fired out the back at whoever is tailing you.

blackout.name: Blackout
blackout.description: The car vents black smog and goes dark. Nothing can lock on to you or track you until it clears or you fire.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.description: Welded plates slam shut around the car. Takes no damage for a few seconds.
